newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm on crude in quiet holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm on crude in quiet holiday trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha strengthened on Monday in line with crude gains at the end of last week, but physical activity was minimal in a quiet holiday market, trader said.
May swaps were assessed around $185/$186 cif NWE while June traded at about $191, reflecting expectations of healthier demand in June.
"It's up on crude," one trader said. "There's very little else going on."
Earlier, a trading house was heard bidding at $186 for pipeline spec material for delivery between May 25 and June 5.
Most of Europe was on holiday on Monday.
